elements_not_encoded.reason: Header of the urgent management list; management is out of scope.

elements_not_encoded.text: If short of breath or oxygen saturation < 95%, give oxygen: 1-4L/min via nasal prongs or 6-10L/min via facemask, up to 10-15L/min via non-rebreather mask. Aim f
If tension pneumothorax likely: insert large bore cannula2 above 6th rib, anterior axillary line. Arrange urgent chest tube.
If shock/systolic BP < 80, give sodium chloride 0.9% 500mL IV over 30 minutes, repeat until systolic BP > 80. Continue 1L 6 hourly. Stop if breathing worsens.
If severe pneumonia (2 or more of: confusion/decreased level of consciousness, BP < 90/60, RR ≥ 30 or age > 65): give ceftriaxone3 1g IV/IM.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Ceftriaxone for severe pneumonia; the severe-pneumonia definition only selects treatment, and age > 65 is not representable.

judgment_calls.decision: Probable tension pneumothorax = sudden-onset dyspnoea AND one unilateral sign (hyperresonance / decreased breath sounds / chest pain) AND displaced trachea AND BP < 90/60; the priority rule references (active_condition Tension pneumothorax).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Treat each listed feature as its own urgent criterion (fires far more often, e.g. BP < 90/60 alone), or require only sudden breathlessness plus a one-sided sign.

judgment_calls.decision: 'Cough < 2 weeks' = (<= (onset Cough) (time_ago 2 weeks)); '>= 2 weeks' = (>= ... (time_ago 2 weeks)); 'recurrent' = Cough/Difficulty breathing with Recurrent qualifier; 'not recurrent' = (no Cough+Recurrent).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Chronic cough / Acute cough precoordinated concepts (no fixed duration in SNOMED).

judgment_calls.decision: Smoker or ex-smoker AND cough onset at least 2 years ago.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Chronic cough concept; no way to express 'most days of 3 months each year'.

judgment_calls.decision: (active_condition Heart failure) in the urgent rule, per Will's pattern for red-box likely diagnoses.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Use the raw orthopnea+leg swelling findings so that known chronic heart failure alone does not make every cough urgent.

judgment_calls.decision: A measure task triggered by Kussmaul's respiration, although glucose is a routine vital, because the page ties the measurement to this sign.
judgment_calls.alternatives: No task (routine vital), leaving rapid deep breathing unencoded.
